title: STNFS at required excess 1.1, 164k pool on theta 5/16, band strip, f-first ECM, weight-200 merge, ten LA owners, re-optimised descent: 120.3872

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 target, the complete STNFS algorithm in proof.md and DESCENT.md with the REFINEMENT.md refinements, 99.9% ECM, X2 = 2^64, required relation excess 1.1 (the whole region is collected and every retained relation, >= 2^63.6617 = 1.157 U, is filtered and used by the descent; the matrix is charged with filtering tables measured at excess 1.1, an over-estimate of N at the larger actual excess), theta = 2330/8000 collection estimated on a fresh 164,000-draw pool sampled on theta = 5/16 (seeds 5-6; rows with Q_a(a)/A^2 < 0.02 credited no yield) (proof.md), the measured record route, the re-measured recentred slice12 kernel table (KERNELS.md), f-first cofactorisation with early abort, the weight-200 merge and the STORAGE.md/row_tail.c kernels with ten active owners returns Q satisfying e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity P, with success at least 0.3901 (and hence at least 0.39) under disclosed heuristics H1-H5 (with H4u: at least 88% of the filtered matrix row weight is +-1 entries, measured at weight 100 and 200 and at excess 1.1; the weight-200 ratio N(200)/N(100) <= 0.80 and N/U not rising above the measured 2^15..2^18 values at excess 1.1 are part of H3). It computes two GT logarithms and returns Q=[a]Q0, handling z=1 directly. All classical work is bounded by a global meter at 2^120.3872 dense-Fp12 units, C=20,000 instructions, with upper-rounded ledger rows summing to <= 2^120.3872 (2^120.3871940). ECM succeeds with 99.9% per prime; X2 = 2^64; theta=2330/8000 (16033 rows, a-radius 781; retained relations >= 2^63.6617, 0.0728 bits = 2.00 pool SE above 1.1 U) with slacks (295, 226), allowance 1.0174, line sieve (scores only) for primes below 2^48 and record walk for [2^48, 2^64), survivors stripping (2^20, 2^48] primes by two rounds per side of the 48-bit ECM schedule (a missed band prime loses the relation, charged in the yield), alpha (5.15, 0.85), primes in [2^63, 2^64) charged twice, records routed at 10.01 each and re-read at 7.003; the g-side band strip and ECM run only after the f side factors, charged with probability q_f = 100 rho(u_f)/P(omitted_f <= slack_f) per row: collection <= 2^119.9297 units (charged mean 311.6 instructions per cell). The polynomials, factor-base bound, filtering, kernels and target remain those of the cited source; the 62-node descent plan (v13's coordinate-search plan re-optimised by the same kind of coordinate search at the inputs LOG2_RELS = 63.661 and mean norms 739.9/498.9: 30 entries move by a few steps, boot (215, 344, 14, 4); refinement.json) is evaluated at UDUP = 0.65 and THIN_MAX 85. Linear algebra (STORAGE.md, row_tail.c: mean weight 201 after merging to weight 200, 20.7 instructions per sparse entry, 1,640 per row for the ten-owner six-limb transfers, combination and the reduction mod r, 97 per dense term, 420 per further 9-limb reduction, N = 0.80 x 1.066 x 0.05797 U = 2^59.1130 < 10 x 2^56 at excess 1.1 and the v4 means, Block Wiedemann blocks (19, 4)) is <= 2^117.7456 units, generator <= 2^107.0986. Descent credits UDUP = 0.65 distinct relations per raw relation (relation-weighted E[shat/m]/pr >= 1.06 boot / >= 4.70 nodes, uniform cells), forces discard only up to 2^90, and keeps 18 boot relations. Expected two-log work is bounded by 2^116.4941; the two-log meter is 2^117.221; Markov abort probability is <= 0.6042008. Other upper bounds are boot failure 1.573e-03 per log, expected nodes 2^18.24, node abort 2^-9.06 and repeats 2^-10.70, with 2/r statistical distance charged. All preprocessing, failed attempts, advice, arithmetic, transfers, sorting, verification and output are included; nothing amortized. Numerical-certificate construction receives an extra 2^50-unit allowance. Memory is at most 2^105 bytes. Source smoothness and production extrapolations stay explicit heuristics. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Bounded audit of recorded full-recurrence evidence, upward-rounded ledger and success, unchanged prime-window endpoints, and nonzero lower/upper integration controls. Does not rerun the full recurrence.

Rerun the package's filtering simulation (filtsim.py) at relation excess 1.1 (default; optional 'excess') to mean weight 100 or 200 (default 200) and report the fraction of row weight carried by +-1 entries (against the charged 0.88) and U/N. Optional (the hosted initial run is the bounded audit). Evidence at its scale only; production is extrapolated (H4u, H3).

Optional full recomputation of certificates, region, ledger (recentred kernels, early abort, weight-200 LA, ten-owner row tail with owner_schedule check), retention, ECM, descent and declared bounds (about 125 s natively; longer when emulated).
